  • Date: Wed, 12 Dec 79 15:07:00 GMT

I found the following:

SA%	PUSHJ P,SUNAME
   .... <conditionalized-out cruft>
	MOVEM A,SUDIR

Clearly bogus.  I made it
SA% IT%	PUSHJ P,SUNAME
IT$	.SUSET [.RSNAME,,TT]
IT$	PUSHJ P,SIXATM
	....
	MOVEM A,SUDIR
